result.reason: The operative change reduces the automatic-renewal non-renewal notice period from 90 to 30 days, satisfying the fallback requirement of no more than 60 days. The clause contains no right to increase prices, so it does not permit an increase exceeding the fallback cap. The edit is narrowly tailored and preserves the annual renewal structure and other terms. It does not reach the preferred position because it omits the 60-day Vendor reminder and an express CPI/3% cap.
